blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
An interview is a conversation between the recruiter and the candidate. The recruiter asks questions to know the person.

The candidate talks about their experience, their skills, and why they want the job. You do not need difficult words. You just need to be honest and friendly.

Good interviews are calm and clear. Simple English is enough.

items.q: Who asks the questions in an interview?
items.why: "The recruiter asks questions to know the person."

items.q: What does the candidate talk about?
options: Their experience, skills and why they want the job
items.why: "The candidate talks about their experience, their skills, and why they want the job."

items.q: According to the text, what kind of English do you need?
items.why: "You do not need difficult words. You just need to be honest and friendly."

items.q: The text suggests that a good candidate is…
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que boas entrevistas são calmas e claras, e que você precisa ser honesto e amigável.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: You must use difficult words to sound good.
The recruiter wants to know the person.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz claramente que você não precisa de palavras difíceis.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver na entrevista com Ana. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi Ana, thank you for coming today. I am Oliver, and I work in the HR team here at Czarnikow. Please relax. This is just a simple conversation.

First, can you tell me about your current role? What do you do every day? And where did you work before this job? I like to know a little about your experience.

Now, an important question. Why do you want to join Czarnikow? What do you like about our company? Please be honest with me.

I also want to know about your skills. What are your main strengths? And how do you handle pressure when the work is very busy?

One more thing. When can you start? We need someone soon, so this is important for us. Take your time, Ana. There are no wrong answers today. Just speak clearly and tell me the truth.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Oliver work?
options: In the HR team at Czarnikow
items.why: "I am Oliver, and I work in the HR team here at Czarnikow."

items.q: What does Oliver ask about Ana's past?
options: Where she worked before this job
items.why: "where did you work before this job?"

items.q: Which question does Oliver ask about difficult days at work?
options: How do you handle pressure when the work is very busy?
How long is your lunch break?
How much do you want to earn?
How many people do you know here?
items.why: "how do you handle pressure when the work is very busy?"

items.q: Why does Oliver ask when Ana can start?
options: Because the company needs someone soon
Because he is in a hurry to leave
items.why: Inferência: "We need someone soon, so this is important for us."

items.q: How does Oliver want Ana to feel in the interview?
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "Please relax", "be honest" e "there are no wrong answers today".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The recruiter called Ana on Monday." A recruiter is a person who…
options: hires new people for a company
items.why: Recruiter = recrutador(a): a pessoa que contrata gente para a empresa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Ana has five years of ___ in trade."
items.why: Experience = experiência: os anos de trabalho na área.

items.q: "English is one of Ana's best skills." A skill is…
options: a thing you can do well
items.why: Skill = habilidade: algo que você faz bem.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Ana wants to ___ the marketing job at Czarnikow."
items.why: To apply for = candidatar-se a uma vaga.

items.q: "A good candidate is honest." Honest means…
items.why: Honest = honesto: quem diz a verdade.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem numa entrevista de emprego. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please tell me about yourself." The recruiter wants you to…
options: give a short talk about who you are
items.why: Tell me about yourself = fale um pouco sobre você (de forma curta e clara).

items.q: "Who do you report to in your current job?" This asks…
items.why: Report to = a quem você se reporta, ou seja, seu chefe.

items.q: "What are your main strengths?" Your strengths are…
items.why: Strengths = pontos fortes: as coisas boas que você faz bem.

items.q: "Ana works hard, but she wants to move on." To move on means to…
options: go to a new job or step
items.why: Move on = seguir em frente, ir para um novo passo ou emprego.

items.q: "Can you fill me in on your last job?" This means…
items.why: Fill me in = me conte os detalhes, me atualize.
